details:
**Summary**

On desktop mode, enabling Selfie Expression (webcam upper-body tracking) always fails with:

"Selfie Expression disabled: Webcam incompatible or in use by another app"

The webcam itself works fine in other apps (Google Meet, VTube Studio), and no other app is using it. The same error occurs with the physical webcam and with OBS Virtual Camera (including a 4:3 canvas), so it is not a camera problem.

**Environment**

- Windows PC, Steam install of VRChat, desktop mode

- Webcam: Buffalo BSW300MBK (appears as "USB 2.0 Camera")

**Log evidence**

Every enable attempt logs the same error in output_log:

Error - NOT_FOUND: Unable to open file at hand_landmarker.bytes [MediaPipeTasksStatus='601']

Mediapipe.BadStatusException at Mediapipe.Tasks.Vision.HandLandmarker.HandLandmarker.CreateFromOptions

**What was checked**

- The file DOES exist in the install: VRChat_Data\StreamingAssets\hand_landmarker.bytes (7,819,041 bytes, alongside face_landmarker_v2_with_blendshapes.bytes)

- Steam "Verify integrity of game files" completes, but the error remains.

- In-game "clear cache" does not fix it.

- Quitting all other camera apps, restarting VRChat, and lowering tracking quality do not fix it.

- There is no copy of the file under AppData\LocalLow\VRChat.

**Workaround found**

Copying hand_landmarker.bytes and face_landmarker_v2_with_blendshapes.bytes from VRChat_Data\StreamingAssets into the VRChat install root folder (next to VRChat.exe) makes the NOT_FOUND error disappear from the log, and Selfie Expression starts working normally.

This suggests the model file path is being resolved relative to the install root / working directory instead of StreamingAssets in some environments.

**Request**

Please fix the model path resolution so the MediaPipe model files load from StreamingAssets as installed.
title: Selfie Expression fails: "Webcam incompatible" — MediaPipe hand_landmarker.bytes NOT_FOUND although the file exists in StreamingAssets
